about: SIMULATED. The impact-analysis claims a coding agent made on 10 December 2026, before T21 to T25, when asked what deleting an escalation rule would touch in Relay 4.21.0. The wording is the book's; no model produced it. Each claim names a kind of check prkit.claims can run against the source in data/relay-4.21.0.
asked: What in Relay 4.21.0 does deleting an escalation rule touch? List each claim so it can be checked.

claims.text: Only src/relay/escalation/store.py reads or writes the esc_rules table.
Only the service's GET route looks a rule up by ID with rule_document, so a deleted rule only needs a 404 there.
No test asserts that the outbox is empty, so new outbox messages cannot break the suite.
esc_audit's outcome column accepts any text, so recording a deletion needs no schema change.
In src, save_rule is called only by the service's PUT route.
The worker already calls run_pass on every loop, so a deleted rule stops firing within a second.
The OpenAPI description lists six operations.
The refusal matrix expects 405 for DELETE on a rule today.
